data.one_liner: Flutter package to connect, listen to, and send messages over TCP sockets.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter applications to establish a TCP socket connection with an IP address and port. It provides methods to connect asynchronously, listen for messages with or without an end-of-message (EOM) delimiter, and send text messages encoded in UTF-8.
use_when: You need to communicate directly with a backend or device over raw TCP sockets.
You are building a custom text-based protocol over TCP in Flutter.
avoid_when: You are working with high-level protocols like HTTP, WebSockets, or gRPC where standard networking packages are more suitable.
strengths: Supports connecting with timeout and retry attempts.
Handles reading data via UTF-8 encoding with optional EOM (End of Message) splits.
Includes helper method to check connectivity before connecting.
weaknesses: Limited to raw TCP sockets and UTF-8 string messages.
No documentation regarding binary data handling.
